title: Los mayas
goal: Read in depth about Maya writing, mathematics and astronomy, and explain what recent evidence suggests about why southern cities were abandoned.

items: Explain why Maya writing was so hard to decipher, and how that changed.
Describe the Maya number system and its two calendars.
Name a Maya architectural achievement and what makes it remarkable.
Explain what new evidence suggests about the southern Maya collapse.
Use ser + participle and se-passive to describe historical events.
I can explain why Maya writing was so hard to decipher, and how that changed.
I can describe the Maya number system and its two calendars.
I can name a Maya architectural achievement and what makes it remarkable.

I can use ser + participle and se-passive to describe historical events.
